notes.title: Amazing Frog? 2 Needed some love.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/6f11be7dd4dd58928263f8cf85a6ba428e629e1c.gif[/img]

While working on Games, sometimes things need a little love. Recently with Amazing Frog? 2 it had become a major priority to go through a bunch of the systems and make a bunch of fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/782a5d88a2b987bc596b04803f8abaa51ee336a0.png[/img]

We thought it would be in the best interest of ongoing development to spend some time agressively fixing as many bugs and broken systems as we could and indeed make some system improvements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/a0d40988c773ebd3e1611b9be0226ab5bd609760.gif[/img]

Yes, when you shoot another player with balloon they should be able to fly, if you have played the last few versions of Amazing Frog? 2 we have been pushing it through a transition stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/268bce725a49baccf3505fff241379e1c401ab69.gif[/img]

Unfortunaley, not all game development is just adding new content,  Often mainterance updates like this one are critical. But at least Its Valentines! And our main focus has been the Frog Life around town and general physics stability.

[h2]Its the Valentines event until the End of Feb...[/h2]
Luckily, the Valentines system also in need of some maintenence...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/f9ac2305cb7b898d5f83bcc02ef3b4232e3c9ba7.jpg[/img]
If you Shoot Frogs with Heart Arrows

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/515fe395b7cd84596398ad4683fd7e058ed8e722.jpg[/img]
You should expect 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/553aeaee52dce5fc48766cacb090bc4261770043.jpg[/img]
some love

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/938887f07bc128ffaae8597f073537bdf40d1aba.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gang Frogs temporaily removed[/h2]
We had to look at how Frogs were spawned into the world and then managed. While they were part of a system in development, we have made a temporary break from the Motor-Bike-Helmet-Wearing-Hooligan-Gang frogs that were messing with you where ever you went in town. (Gangs will return as gangs)

(Don't worry, if you crave violence you can still start a purge)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/352d207d0c4a191fff2c3c9472a956008e9c5938.png[/img]

If you want to...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/d090ab7eab7fb0a0ef0f5187ecb5f43dd19fcf9d.png[/img]

[h2]So Whats Next? [/h2]
Towards the latter part of 2024 we were more focused on Amazing Frog? QMMT . Certainly in this first half of 2025, I expect that we will need to continue with our primarily focus on bringing "Law and Order" to Amazing Frog? QMMT.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/c757022ab3900fbc7d990d1a25edf59ac7728aaf.jpg[/img]
Its no secret that we have been working on a giant Snake for Amazing Frog?2  and indeed the arcade game system. Many aspects of Amazing Frog?2  have been in development along side QMMT. I won't go into detail, but many things we started developing some time ago and are still in active development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/9214071eb00468c5bd866672108facca65c9bb06.jpg[/img]
While we had naturally hoped to get this giant snake terrorizing Swindon in Feburary, we found that to do justice to this system and indeed many of the other systems in Development for Amazing Frog? 2 we need to make further improvements to the game architechture including a move to Unity 6.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/a2fe170db5ea0827171c8d699bf49dbbb2dfafd6.jpg[/img]

Expect Snakes.

notes.title: Amazing Frog? 2 New beginnings
notes.content:
[h3]Hello and Happy New year![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/37def365ec53b80673e05d6e7164c5024cd6db20.gif[/img]
We know its been a while since we updated Amazing Frog? 2
Those of you that follow what we do, will know its because we have been making huge leaps forward with QMMT.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/57c6cd567a3b653ba72dade7a58fd6bb3896c177.jpg[/img]
We are still workling on Amazing Frog? 2 ! We have been working on Amazing Frog? 2 and we will continue to do so until Hell Freezes over - This update is a new beginning for us. As we update QMMT and Amazing Frog? 2 they will benefit each other since they share the same core that we have been developing over the past few years.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/2686cd4f3a7ae7a1c9b1ba228ba5405aa27597c5.gif[/img]
As far as content goes, where I mean things line new vehicles and new weapons, challenges and collectables QMMT has recieved the lions share of that effort (mainly because it its close to console release). However since the last update in March for Amazing Frog?2  we have been working on establishing a more robust world with a day night cycle. Safeguarding the future of Amazing Frog? As and small indie we have think outside the box about how to protect future development, especially after what we experienced with legacy where unity progress made our game unupdatable :(

[h3]Moving on...[/h3]
One of the new major features is Swindon Town. This pretty much runs on a Steam Deck even and allows access to Swindon without the rest of the world.
[h3]A screenshot from Hal's steamdeck[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/c61cd00c5c4fbf7eefd07c02f658cf1c8d6b8eb9.jpg[/img]
(that he just set me on discord)

At the end of the day us building this massive world is the experimental bit, but there is no need fighting frogs and driving cars and F.A.P.S. in Swindon to require a super fas PC so try out swindon Town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/6f77f4253cf4526fa483c1d878b94257adbadcb1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/bfa43e3e644e18e48ac219a434015c9b3501db70.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/ce74da37372b26b422cedbbfad48ca14fc57891d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/315186571b2fa2c4bac2172d7f0ba28dd32af54d.jpg[/img]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/ef1a8889430ac7a0e280c69bf56de0b9bba5b66b.jpg[/img]

There is still lots to do, 
Our journey for increased performance in Amazing Frog? 2 is not yet complete and we will be moving the project to Unity 6 in the new year and expect even better results.
We want the day to last longer and the day night cycle to drive more dynamic content and it will.
For now however we only really intended for the Zombies to come out at night ... they are always there... whoops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/0baa6e4912dfa2802a328a5df2b65d899eb36c3b.jpg[/img]
 
The experimental stuff in Amazing Frog? 2 is still there and we will continue to expand this part of Amazing Frog? 2
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/5f560afc33f87055c4632ef8c58c5b092f403547.gif[/img]
For now, we only had time to do an update to Windows (64) i will do patch in the new year for the other platforms and some fixes 
Thanks!

notes.title: Development News in Amazing Frog? 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/7d341ad031117671f647b3c31b6198badb46d3bc.jpg[/img]

While  Amazing Frog? QMMT (Quest for the Magical Mystery Toilet) is about to leave Early Access after 10 years, Amazing Frog? 2 which we feel has so much more scope for the future is, lets face it just getting started. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/76b26aedb9a92d80738864da485a5b480b1bd7da.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone, it's Hal again with an update on what I've been working on for the next release of 
Amazing Frog? 2.
Lately, my focus has been on finalising a more streamlined and stable version of the Swindonshire 
world. This involves implementing new technology and pipelines from QMMT to handle plant and 
grass placement and rendering, along with resolving some lingering issues—like fixing sunlight 
leaking into the rail tunnels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/19cb7c91b310e201ff451bd3a4ccad6206eff79e.jpg[/img]
As I’ve mentioned before, many of these systems will now be powered by Houdini, allowing us to 
place assets more intelligently and add new features faster. While building assets for AF2 takes 
longer due to our goal of higher graphical fidelity, these new tools, alongside the engine 
improvements Gaz is working on, should speed up content creation and variation in the long run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/bffe6f741c1d0cff160da291b2f5f3a43401e7b2.jpg[/img]
This past week, I’ve been refining the terrain under the town. Some areas needed to be lowered to 
accommodate basement levels, while others had to align perfectly with roads and sidewalks. 
Although the process seems straightforward, moving everything into Houdini for better control has 
added some complexity. I sculpt the terrain in Unity, convert it into a mesh, and then use that 
mesh like a stamp to transfer the details back into Houdini’s heightfield. While more tedious, this 
workflow ensures the world remains adaptable and saves time in the long run, especially when 
making large-scale changes or adding new plant types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/7229b5c0b3991e2e6de15f79261c945bbeff6e51.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/4f8766e065d8c9ea40bca3735775e37efc25a247.jpg[/img]

 I’ve also been refining the trees and the tools I’ve built to generate them. I’ve developed a tool in 
Houdini where I can ‘design’ a tree and have it generate multiple variations (so that they don’t all 
look exactly the same). The system also generates all necessary LOD (Level of Detail) and 
collision meshes for different viewing distances.
We now have four LOD stages for our trees:
 • The closest LOD uses a shader that distorts the surface by scaling the vertex positions. This 
adds a "fluffy" appearance without relying on too much geometry, keeping rendering efficient.
 • The next two LODs are simplified versions of the trunk and foliage, using non-transparent 
materials for better performance.
 • The farthest LOD is an "imposter"—a flat quad that displays a baked image of the tree, 
drastically reducing the cost of rendering forests, as distant trees are just billboards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/2b03204e6b153e715df275c8a1c424d23ad4a4ce.jpg[/img]

 One of the perks of using Houdini for tree generation is the ability to add creative touches without 
spending extra time. For example, I baked vertex colour noise into the foliage meshes and 
projected it onto lower LODs. This allows the shaders to apply subtle colour variations to the 
leaves, ensuring consistency across different LOD levels. We’ve also implemented crossfading 
between LODs, reducing the visual “popping” that often occurs when transitioning between levels 
of detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/fbf34565df655f70ab7160cae149f54f3258b39d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/b7bc5af85555f0a793f990740a82468b88c462c8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/1aa16112af43bc53f6f3078ad39ae72cd915079d.png[/img]

Looking ahead to next week, I’ll be tackling one of the more exciting tasks. Now that Gaz has 
migrated the codebase from QMMT, we can better utilise physics zones and populate the world 
with more frogs and content. Expect AF2 to feature more frogs than ever before, each with 
distinct roles and purposes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/4c2b6cca9a16e155a13774c7f6d0af0f42cce0ec.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Amazing Frog? Xmas Sandbox Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/ffdf46a1fa230640269e2b3902e8302014bb717a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Welcome to Everything Sandbox.[/h2]
A new category in the menu System called Sandbox. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/790c6df7738d378a9dc92e8c6ee507217b13d5d0.jpg[/img]

Yeah, its literally a Giant Sandbox.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/2d9e7b747dcdc4f2b04bc4d4d9de5b4cccd38288.jpg[/img]

If you know what a F.A.P.S. ( Fairly Accurate Placement System ) Desk then you will be familiar with how this works in Amazing Frog? 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/b05adc87594d5074a0405fdfa27fb569fadcc5ac.jpg[/img]

The F.A.P.S. Desk came about because we had been developing so many different types of Vehicle, creatures, accessories, weapons etc etc, that we needed to be able to gameplay test them rapidly making different combination. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/ebf82057f962c3c30883d7918525181b1e811763.jpg[/img]
 
And while you know we love our unlocks in Amazing Frog? by finding F.A.P.S. Disks  often its nice to just have access to a bunch of content and just place them next to each other and see what happens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/72c3acafddf7df8780a881ac5cd8f81b0ca862df.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/0d91ea4beaf6af78d5bf1ea25ab5d154069650d4.jpg[/img]

Sometime in Development the F..A.P.S. Desk has been so helpful... but also really addictive, weird and fun. I have often lost too much time just experimenting with different combos... but I do have all the Disks.
Apart from the giant Sandbox we also have Winter island where the F.A.P.S. desk has a bunch of festive FAPS Disks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/0a983ea5d378362795731b7c2554743392d2f998.jpg[/img]

With these two Sandbox worlds, we have also been creating other worlds for Amazing Frog?2 (Its all part of a larger development plan.) Winter Island is one of these.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/f06aa4696034e9f45b1bab97b38665a48f76507d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Visit Tiny Islands[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/1694d75f372425272f8fd1a410ab718a586ee15d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/f3e820023d6c0352478837d980462113fae3d19d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/3b0df76863121b8e3c8da388704a5c275725c189.jpg[/img]

[h2]Collect things in the Toy Room[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/93f9420b498e800a12e19219b9db21b63346b990.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/603963d8d287a93cb9e966a2fa71d44b5cb99bde.jpg[/img]

We have a whole bunch of other worlds to come too.

What about Swindon shire?
Well it may run better for many players The main reason I didn't call this a "Major" update in that I know Swindonshire needs more attention and we are very close to a world refresh for Swindonshire in AF?2 but its not quite ready, but we really wanted you to share in the sandbox ness these Holidays.  There have had been some pretty fundamental  physics updates that should help, but we haven't had bunches of time to test so be warned some strange things may well  happen in this update. 

And more to follow very soon.

Hey FAPpy Holidays !

notes.title: Amazing Frog? 2 Sandbox
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/b2b61ec2660fa28579984da15e775da209f77530.png[/img]

We have some exciting news for Amazing Frog? 2. 
A Major Update, the Sandbox Update will be available soon.

Recently, we dropped "V3" from the name in favour of "Amazing Frog? 2". A bit of rebranding as we give Amazing Frog? 2 its independence. I actually wrote a few blog posts that I never posted attempting to explain this, but in the end I felt it was self explanatory.

So, if you bought Amazing Frog? or Amazing Frog? 2 before today nothing will change and you will continue own both apps in your library, but from today we will be selling Amazing Frog? and Amazing Frog? 2 separately ( or in a bundle, I guess).

Amazing Frog? 2 began its development with every intention to become an iterative  "update" to Amazing Frog? Things change... the scope changed, software changed, possibilities changed and we ended up working on two projects moving in different directions. 
We now have two games:

Amazing Frog? 2 

and

Amazing Frog? (the Quest for the Magical Mystery Toilet)
 

I don't like "Road Maps" It makes me feel super uncomfortable to state what we are going to do as things change in development and we often need the flexibility to adapt. But I can outline a simple top line Road Map for both projects.

[h3]Amazing Frog? 2[/h3]  Has become our more Experimental development environment. In the Sandbox update we are opening up a series of new environments and giving you access to more unlocked FAPS disk items to use in the new "Everything Sandbox" mode. We will give access to the Swindon Games island, Winter Island, Tiny Islands and a couple of emerging environments with tentative starting names the Toy room and Zombie Land.

Sandbox

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/d1983f44147b3c576066c09610ad436206870752.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/e213f5ef055912036942ecb32ce18b67a4006e1d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/477309e8a078f954158ec6eeca5a6ff0e8c8cf34.jpg[/img]

Toy Room

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/741e5ab550b26add678d4c0506807e54cf90f45a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/7efdcfb34ff17bf533599d36179b1d3aa850064d.jpg[/img]


Zombie Land

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/e90f4d502dac5a7b38f0b1f4a14dbdeb6509864a.jpg[/img]

Tiny Islands

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/88e5ef62ede0f1ce746eb7c956778cde94282854.jpg[/img]

[h3]Amazing Frog? QMMT[/h3] has evolved to be a kind of open world free roaming adventure game and will leave early Access very soon. We are building for other platforms since it is now in a highly portable state. We will continue to update Amazing Frog? QMMT especially here on Steam, complete the Legacy Remastering process, flight school, magic toilet etc and of course continue to introduce more activities,  a bunch of new vehicles, new beasts and Amazing Frog? QMMT part 3 is next... You can find out more about QMMT here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/332570

So far this year the Updates for Amazing Frog?2 have been "seasonal" Easter, Valentines and lunar new year...(Really looking forward to year of the Dragon....) We wanted to implement a perpetual season system within Swindonshire. Meaning that the bunny outfits would become available every easter, Pumpkins for October, Santa Heads and crazy elf frogs in the Holiday season. Looking at where we are at, I can't believe the last update was easter! 
It has been a major advantage being small allowing us to continue to develop in perpetuity, but the down side of being a small developer is that things take time. 

Update coming very soon.

notes.title: The Amazing Year of The Rabbit?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/1d1608118d0c3925596bec9b039272555281c99a.gif[/img]

V3 Gets another Update, but  WARNING:: The Lunar New Year Content is timed...

So get geared up, Its Time to grab your 'Year of the Rabbit' themed Stuff..
[h3]Get it before the end of January![/h3]

[previewyoutube=VumNa35zHMI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Find the Lucky Gold Rabbits and grab their red packets to earn your themed gear.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/6339cbb9a3fa597e15c38d2614e77feb7b7ef609.jpg[/img]

Basically, Find 'em...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/cf66d2d873840277c6838975d8467c7de8849935.jpg[/img]

..Kick 'em...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/1d28e36f1d86fd905fb21cbb6d37d3d9f2840901.gif[/img]

...or Shoot 'em! 

Your choice...

Just do it before the end of January  ( [i]or change your system clock..[/i]. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/f12f4cd9ab7f44177a597087d6537964be1d1e66.jpg[/img]

[b]DEV TECH INFO[/b] - These updates where you collect 'currency' and unlock stuff are helping us grow the underlying systems that will enable us to provide a robust and expansive inventory and shopping system within the world. We have been limiting the collection activities to what we see as secondary quests for now. Seasonal activities are a good place to trial these systems  as they come around each year.  As for the more permanent in-game quests and jobs that we have been developing, they will grow from these 'experiments' before we commit them to the release branch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/f4f7659e6b0339a335025b0cc0ac8ca210871405.gif[/img]

[h3] Boom ! Also in this update[/h3]
Passenger seats for Helicopters and Biplanes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/450d63b80d688d73a734ba046355d54c4e9ef31e.gif[/img]

Golf clubs? I think we put them in over xmas actually.. but we improved them slightly. Hal made a golf ball... um but we forgot to put it in

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/bb33d71f67eeb319a9ad2126b7e83a423d8222bc.gif[/img]

As with every update we try and fix as many bugs as we can and try and make as many improvements as possible

NOTE : These yellow and white full bunny costumes - If you don't have them, they will return at Easter Also Pretty sure there will be more bunny/rabbit 'things' happening this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/5351e411b036c79743846271bd4c4a0715db0808.gif[/img]

[h3]So ... About V3 Progress... [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/eacc0fd7921077ac3e0fdde4d86dabb806a0b2c8.jpg[/img]

[b]DEV TECH INFO[/b] - We know that some of these updates for V3 have been a bit 'samey'... smaller, calendar based events... Much of our time spent on V3 has been frustratingly invisible for the past few months as we have been preparing Amazing Frog? V3 for its next major phase of development.
We are converting the project to a new Render Pipeline and when this process is complete outputs from this new branch of development will bring improvements in quality, performance and also perhaps more importantly expose the project to the possibility of adding support for awesome features such as Texture Steaming, Real Time Ray Tracing and DLSS
...its a lot of work and hope to share more of that soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42529574/8b5a1ff53e103e4d2e8b1c2c9a6a02f8e43b5aa1.jpg[/img]

[ Note to V2 Remastered players... I am working on the moon right now, as you are reading this :)  ]
